hero.imageAlt: ECRT projects — high-speed rolling stock, catenary and rail infrastructure

directions.title: Areas of activity
directions.intro: We engineer innovative onboard and train-level solutions for a high‑speed fleet, focused on passenger comfort, accessibility, and richer cabin services. Those subsystems converge in a modular, distributed train control backbone built around a unified Russian‑developed hardware‑and‑software platform with intelligent traction, supervisory, and diagnostic functions across multiple rolling-stock configurations.

cab-displays-controls.title: Driver-cab supervisory and indication systems
cab-displays-controls.detail: We have engineered an integrated suite of controllers and onboard computers that delivers centralised surveillance and traction control for high-speed trains that may be operated single‑handed.

onboard-energy.title: Auxiliary onboard power supply architecture
onboard-energy.detail: Intelligent power distribution strategies tailor energy delivery to auxiliary consumers while reacting to instantaneous load swings and monitored equipment condition.

microclimate-passenger.title: Microclimate conditioning for saloons and onboard service spaces
microclimate-passenger.detail: Active climate management for passenger saloons and service rooms keeps occupants comfortable throughout the itinerary. Built around a networked controller, the system continuously adapts airflow, humidity, and temperature thresholds to prevailing weather and real‑time occupancy.

microclimate-driver.title: Microclimate conditioning in driver cabs
microclimate-driver.detail: Dedicated cab climate management ensures ergonomically safe zones for locomotive crews, using supervisory hardware that tracks exterior weather and trims cab comfort setpoints accordingly.

traction-force.title: Traction provisioning for high-speed trains
traction-force.detail: Advanced torque blending supports launch, cruising, and coasting manoeuvres within passenger‑comfort envelopes. Adaptive logic inside the programmable traction controller allocates effort across motors and axle sets in real time.

traction-aero.title: Assessment of aerodynamic performance
traction-aero.detail: High‑fidelity CFD studies capture trainset envelopes at target line speeds plus crosswind spectra. Outputs feed traction sizing so acceleration profiles remain within specification.

onboard-infotainment.title: Passenger-facing information & entertainment networks
onboard-infotainment.detail: We designed mission‑critical infotainment and crew information systems interconnected over a hardened onboard Ethernet/IP backbone to improve service workflows and traveller convenience.

traction-drive.title: Traction converters and motor control
traction-drive.detail: Field‑oriented traction control maximises adhesion utilisation while guarding against wheel slip. Dedicated hardware supervises inverter health throughout the traction chain.

braking.title: Brake blending and retardation coordination
braking.detail: Service and emergency retardation blending respects safety margins and ride quality. Programmable brake management coordinates friction and electrodynamic sources down to standstill and parking brake application.

onboard-diagnostics.title: Onboard trainset diagnostic suite
onboard-diagnostics.detail: Centralised condition monitoring ingests signals from vehicle buses and edge devices, persisting timelines in optimised embedded databases tuned for deterministic IO access.

operational-safety.title: Ensuring safe operation of the high-speed EMU
operational-safety.detail: Hardware and software systems integrate the high-speed train with infrastructure that includes modern interval-regulation signalling, increasing line capacity and train speeds while maintaining the required level of functional safety.

emc.title: Electromagnetic compatibility of the trainset and its systems
emc.detail: Shielding and filtering strategies keep command, control, and IT equipment immune to internal radiated disturbances experienced during high‑speed duty.

electrical-safety.title: Electrical safety and conducted emissions stewardship
electrical-safety.detail: Design rules bound conducted and radiated emissions from power electronics whilst enforcing touch‑safe segregation for maintainers onboard.

tamper-protection.title: Physical and logical safeguards against unauthorised access
tamper-protection.detail: Layered protections lock down consoles, diagnostics ports, and service interfaces so only authorised staff can manipulate safety‑critical endpoints or export sensitive data.

human-machine-interface.title: Human-machine interface engineering
human-machine-interface.detail: We harmonise interaction patterns across passengers and train staff with accessible input modalities and interactive surfaces aligned with contemporary UX expectations inside rolling stock shells.

infrastructure-diagnosis.title: Infrastructure sensing from onboard diagnostic channels
infrastructure-diagnosis.detail: Vibration signatures captured on running gear are streamed into analytics kernels that classify track and civil asset stresses for predictive maintenance pipelines.

air-sanitation.title: Air sanitisation and filtration regimes
air-sanitation.detail: UV‑assisted treatment cycles sanitise conditioned air whilst supervisory logic modulates lamp duty alongside HVAC states to extend UV source life without compromising biosecurity goals.

thermal-monitoring-traction.title: Thermal supervision of motors, gearboxes, and journal boxes
thermal-monitoring-traction.detail: Distributed temperature probes let the onboard microprocessor cluster infer mechanical wear states for rotating machinery long before hard failures appear.
